title: 第 332 章 番外31
slug: 成婚不圆房重生娇娇不嫁他急了
content_zh:
沈明霁无法改变身世，也没法让时光倒流，薛星瑶介意的点，他永远无法扭
听口气，南晴肯定是不知道千魂峰的下落了，休息了一会儿之后，陈志成的法力也差不多恢复了，这才让大家三人一组分开寻找宝藏，找到之后放烟花为信号。
苏影湄一直都没有说话，她不知道，自己该说什么。是该感谢白忆雪吗？可是，苏影湄又觉得，这很讽刺。
元素手印的成功率并不是百分之百的，有可能会失败，失败之后，一个时辰是不能再施展第二次，所以我施展的时候也抱着拼命的想法，只能拼一下。
苏影湄眼中的沈风和杨百川，并不像是分隔了很多年的一对恋人。倒是更加的像是一对搀扶走过了一生的人似的。没有半分的尴尬，一切都显得很是随和。
content_en:
Shen Mingji can't change his life experience, nor can he turn back time. Xue Xingyao doesn't care, he can never change it.
Judging from the tone, Nan Qing must not know the whereabouts of Thousand Souls Peak. After resting for a while, Chen Zhicheng's mana had almost recovered, so he asked everyone to search for the treasure in groups of three. After finding it, they set off fireworks as a signal.
Su Yingmei remained silent. She didn't know what to say. Should I thank Bai Yixue? However, Su Yingmei felt that this was ironic.
The success rate of elemental mudra is not 100%, and it may fail. After failure, you cannot perform it a second time for an hour, so when I performed it, I had the idea of ​​​​desperately trying my best, so I could only give it a try.
In Su Yingmei's eyes, Shen Feng and Yang Baichuan did not look like a pair of lovers who had been separated for many years. It's more like a pair of people helping each other through life. There was no embarrassment at all, everything seemed very easy-going.
